questions.question: Describe the importance of different functional units of a computer system with the help of a block diagram / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Functional units of a computer include Input Unit, Output Unit, Memory Unit, ALU, and Control
  • Unit. Input unit accepts data; memory stores data and programs; ALU performs arithmetic and logic
  • operations; Control Unit manages all operations; Output unit displays results. Data flow: Input →
  • Memory → CPU → Output.

questions.question: Differentiate between arithematic operations and logic operations with example. / [CO2] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Arithmetic operations like ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV perform calculations, while logic operations like
  • AND, OR, XOR, NOT work on bits. Arithmetic affects numerical results; logic changes bit patterns.
  • Example: ADD R1, R2 vs AND R1, R2.
